prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.)
text:
We have been retained by [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully proceeding through an intersection when your insured, while turning left across the path of oncoming traffic, failed to yield the right of way and struck our client's vehicle broadside. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles establish that your insured bears full responsibility for this collision.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a concussion with ongoing symptoms including persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Our client has been under the care of physicians and has been advised to limit work and daily activities while recovering. Medical records and treatment notes documenting these injuries are enclosed, along with records of lost wages and out-of-pocket expenses.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are substantial and well documented. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] in full settlement of all claims against your insured arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.
